answer: An hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The sonnet counter is kept in whisper and dawn makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Repeating the trick 39 times costs 46 separate deposits and 5 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
